items.title: Meta launches an open-weight AI model that runs on Macs
items.content: Meta and Apple have teamed up for the launch of the social media giant's newest model, Muse Spark Open, which will run locally on Apple silicon.

items.title: Judge orders OpenAI to turn over hiring records in Apple trade secrets case
items.content: A federal judge ruled that Apple can access OpenAI's interview materials involving former Apple employees, as well as private messages and testimony from key figures in the ca

items.title: Spotify users on iOS 27 can now ask Siri to play music without having to say ‘on Spotify’
items.content: Siri can now learn users' preferred music app, allowing Spotify listeners to request songs, podcasts, and playlists without specifying which app to use.

items.title: Apple refreshes its HomePod mini with a new chip and $149 price tag
items.content: The new $149 HomePod mini with Siri AI and a 'SoundGlow' visual feature will be available starting October 30.

items.title: Microsoft president says UK is best placed to drive AI regulation
items.content: Microsoft president Brad Smith calls for urgent AI regulation, saying milk and washing machines have more oversight than AI companies.

items.title: Microsoft’s Satya Nadella says AI models need an ‘emergency brake’
items.content: In a Saturday morning post, Microsoft's CEO wrote that it’s time “to step back and assess the trust architecture” of AI.

items.title: US bars Microsoft, Adobe, and major IT firms from green card program for skilled foreign workers
items.content: The other firms being suspended from the program include Capgemini, Cognizant, HCL, Infosys, Tata, and Wipro.

items.title: Microsoft releases new Nvidia-chip AI PCs with revamped Windows 11
items.content: Microsoft revealed the specs and price for its Surface Laptop Ultra, AI PCs that run on Nvidia chips that are designed to run AI models and agents.

items.title: You’ve Found a Long-Lost CD. Can You Still Get Your Money?
items.content: The bank was required to hold the certificate of deposit only for a limited time, and now has no record of the money. Experts offer tips to avoid having this happen to you.

items.title: When Will the Fed Move on Rates?
items.content: Kevin Warsh, the central bank’s chairman, suggested he wouldn’t push to raise borrowing rates this month. But persistent inflation may force the Fed’s hand.

items.title: Indonesian Stocks Plunge as MSCI Threatens to Drop Market from Indexes
items.content: The potential downgrade by MSCI, an influential index provider, adds to a deepening crisis of investor confidence in the economic policies of Indonesian President Prabowo Subi

items.title: Feel Like You’re Overpaying for Hotels? Blame Expedia, a New Lawsuit Says.
items.content: The booking giant is accused of breaking federal antitrust laws and forcing millions of customers to overspend on stays by as much as 30 percent.
